name: Spotify
description: Spotify's home, search, albums, artists, playlists and radios, plus your library and liked songs when signed in (Android and desktop apps; in a browser paste cookies). Audio comes from Spotify itself, the way its web player plays it: a clear MP3, or the DRM-protected MP4/FLAC that Widevine decrypts where the device can (the MP3 is the fallback on Android's WebView and the only kind downloads can save).
